mechanism_narrative: A higher level of residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with robust corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between RSAFS level and 20-day SPX returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) in more than 50% of 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slack indicated by unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals weak consumer spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicates a strong housing market, driving consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both > 0.5% increase in past 1 month
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST and RSAFS both increasing by >0.5% in the past month fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing expansion regime (INDPRO > 105.0), a rising industrial production index signals strong output growth, which drives positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 2000.0 thousand units indicate a weak housing market, correlating with negative consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 2000.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 195.0), rising consumer prices signal potential central bank rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 195.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) consistently indicates expanding manufacturing output, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO growth and 20-day SPX returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) in more than 50% of 3-year rolling windows.
